hero.modificationNotice: Resized, cropped for display and converted to WebP. The adaptation is released under the same licence.
hero.verification: Downloaded the original (3264x2448) from Wikimedia Commons and inspected it directly: the red-brick building lettered 'RAGLAN ROAD' and 'IRISH PUB' at Disney Springs, matching this guide's second named location. The published guide hero was previously generic stock that did not show either of this guide's two real locations; a photo of Halloween Horror Nights' 'Universal Monsters' haunted-house facade was considered but rejected because it primarily reproduces Universal's own copyrighted character artwork (a mural-like installation), the same freedom-of-panorama gap this project treats public art under, rather than U.S.-freedom-of-panorama-covered building architecture; this building-exterior photo of the guide's other named, non-ticketed venue was used instead. No identifiable people are the subject; a few pedestrians are incidental background figures.
